sql:
SELECT md.title AS source_title, kc.metadata->>'section_title' AS section,
  kc.metadata->>'page_number' AS page, 1-(kc.embedding <=> CAST(:embedding AS vector)) AS similarity
FROM knowledge_chunks kc JOIN medical_documents md ON md.id=kc.document_id
WHERE kc.embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY kc.embedding <=> CAST(:embedding AS vector) ASC LIMIT 3
